page_title: AUG 0-0 RBL | Augsburg v RB Leipzig 14/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+2' What a chance that is! Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Total attempts – 11:12.
84' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
84' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
83' A quickly taken corner by RB Leipzig.
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) coming on for Ridle Baku.
82' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) replaces Benjamin Sesko.
82' Jess Thorup is forced to make a change. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is unable to continue due to injury, Henri Koudossou comes on.
81' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
80' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
76' Some neat passing and movement from Augsburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
74' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
74' Arne Maier (Augsburg) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
72' It is time for a substitution. Arne Maier (Augsburg) is on for Fredrik Jensen.
70' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) replacing Castello Lukeba.
70' A substitution has been made. Kevin Kampl is replaced by Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig).
69' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
69' There's an opportunity for Marius Wolf (Augsburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
68' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
67' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
66' 11:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
63' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Christoph Baumgartner and he is replaced by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig).
62' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) for his blatant foul.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Samuel Essende walks off the pitch to be replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
60' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
59' David Raum (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
58' David Raum (RB Leipzig) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
54' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
52' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
51' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) whips in a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi is well positioned and punches the ball away.
49' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
48' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
47' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the right post. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) commits a foul and Sascha Stegemann immediately signals a free kick.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
39' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
39' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes a short corner kick.
37' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' The linesman signals that David Raum (RB Leipzig) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
32' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Sascha Stegemann interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
29' David Raum (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
28' David Raum (RB Leipzig) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Finn Dahmen leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
28' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is about to take a corner kick.
26' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
26' The referee awards a corner and Marius Wolf (Augsburg) goes over to take it.
26' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
25' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' The total number of attempts is 1:4.
15' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Finn Dahmen.
14' A fine solo run by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
13' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
11' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
11' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
10' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) inside the box.
7' The corner from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is hurriedly cleared.
4' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Finn Dahmen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
3' A spell of possession for RB Leipzig in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
